# Lasse Pirk

Lasse Pirk is identified in the corpus as a Datamanager (data manager) at Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut (the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute) [^src1]. He is listed as a member of the steering group ("styregruppe") responsible for the ADHD database, a national Danish clinical quality database [^src1].

Pirk's inclusion reflects the broader structure of the ADHD database's governance: the steering group draws members from all five Danish regions, relevant professional societies, patient organizations, and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut itself [^src1]. As the Institute's representative in a data-manager role, Pirk's presence on the steering group ties him to the oversight of data quality and reporting for the database, which documents ADHD diagnosis and treatment pathways among children, adolescents, and adults across Denmark for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, including regional variation in the use of a pathway marker for disproven suspicions of ADHD [^src1].

The available material is limited to a single listing of his name, title, and employer; no further biographical detail, claims, or timeline events are recorded in the corpus.
